judgments.target_text: planned production cuts for certain products; no exact execution date stated
judgments.value_text: Samsung planned to cut production of certain products after stating that sufficient supply capability had been achieved for those products.
judgments.summary: On the April 11, 2023 disclosure vintage, Samsung communicated a plan to cut production of certain products. The statement is preserved as a contemporaneous management commitment, not proof that a specific DRAM/NAND cut percentage had already been executed.

metadata.product_scope_guard: The source does not identify an exact DRAM/NAND product split.
metadata.magnitude_guard: The source gives no cut percentage.
metadata.reality_guard: Do not convert the plan itself into executed production Reality without separate source evidence.

judgments.value_text: Demand was expected to gradually recover as customer inventory levels declined through inventory adjustments.
judgments.summary: On the April 27, 2023 results vintage, Samsung expected demand to recover gradually during the second half of 2023 as customer inventories declined. This is an immutable contemporaneous forecast; later recovery evidence remains separate.

metadata.mechanism_text: customer inventory levels decline due to inventory adjustments
metadata.hindsight_guard: Later 2023/2024 demand, pricing or inventory outcomes are excluded from this Judgment.
metadata.target_precision_guard: The source supports a half-year window, not an exact recovery date.

judgments.value_text: SK hynix guided to reduce 2023 investment by more than 50% year on year while reducing production volume with focus on less profitable products.
judgments.summary: On the October 26, 2022 earnings vintage, SK hynix guided to cut 2023 investment by more than 50% year on year and to reduce production volume focused on less profitable products. The >50% magnitude belongs only to investment.

metadata.magnitude_scope: greater than 50% applies only to 2023 investment YoY
metadata.production_scope: production reduction is stated without a percentage or exact product-line split
metadata.comparability_guard: Do not compare the investment percentage numerically with Micron's wafer-start reduction.

judgments.target_text: further NAND production reduction; no exact execution date or percentage stated
judgments.value_text: SK hynix decided to further reduce NAND production because NAND inventory levels were higher than DRAM.
judgments.summary: On the July 26, 2023 Q2-results vintage, SK hynix communicated a further NAND production-reduction decision tied to higher NAND inventory than DRAM. This is preserved as a later management commitment, not retroactively inserted into the October 2022 guidance and not treated as proof that the additional reduction had already been executed.

metadata.execution_guard: Decision language does not by itself prove completed execution.
metadata.magnitude_guard: No NAND production percentage is stated; the earlier >50% remains investment-only.
metadata.revision_candidate: This later Judgment is eligible for explicit CAP-0004 revision-family relation to the October 2022 guidance once CAP-0007 composes Judgment context persistence.
